items.title: Sixers will be in their reds tonight here in Brooklyn. Curious to see if Nick Nurse goes to an eight-man rotation without LeBron James. If not, maybe a spot for Labaron Philon Jr., but Brooklyn is a very big team. Would be a Justin Edwards spot if he had inspired any confidence.

items.title: Much, much better night for Justin Edwards down in Delaware. He had 23 points (9/17), 2 ast, 2 stl, 3 fouls after a 1/10 game yesterday.
items.author: Austin Krell
items.body_excerpt:
Much, much better night for Justin Edwards down in Delaware. He had 23 points (9/17), 2 ast, 2 stl, 3 fouls after a 1/10 game yesterday.

Caleb Love had 35 (10/20), 2 reb, 1 ast, 2 stl, 2 tov. 

Coats beat the Maine Celtics by 11 after losing to them by 26 on Friday.

items.title: Greetings from Delaware, where Labaron Philon, Jr., Justin Edwards, and Rayan Rupert are playing for the Blue Coats.
items.author: Austin Krell
items.body_excerpt:
Greetings from Delaware, where Labaron Philon, Jr., Justin Edwards, and Rayan Rupert are playing for the Blue Coats.

Rupert has all 5 for the Coats, who are trailing by 13 early on to the Maine Celtics. VJ Edgecombe is here to support his teammates.

quote.text: Sixers head coach Nick Nurse is leaning towards starting Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, LeBron James and Joel Embiid tonight vs. the Celtics from what I am hearing from very real sources.
